publicSnapshotContract.identity: snapshot.identity contains availability-wrapped matchId / current presented paId / pitchId / situationId. Current PA is never synthesized from the next batter or reused from a settled PA.
publicSnapshotContract.revision: Deterministic fingerprint of public projection only; a view-change indicator, never an execution authorization token.
publicSnapshotContract.readBoundary: simulationLog.slice(0,presentedEventCursor), exclusive cursor. No prepare/ensure/advance helper is called by projection.
publicSnapshotContract.decision: PlateDecision presented/admitted routes are copied from actual legalRoutes. Other observed player-decision boundaries retain waiting=true with routes unsupported and remain with original UI.
publicSnapshotContract.submission: No submit function. chooseHighSchoolYearOneMatchMoment remains the sole existing Match decision entry used by compatibility tests.
publicSnapshotContract.save: Existing persisted source only; no save keys/schema/cache/new authority.

publicTimelineContract.identity: version + original matchId + event type + original source identity
publicTimelineContract.order: Original simulationLog sequence plus actual retained pitch/lifecycle/action evidence order; not physical elapsed time
publicTimelineContract.source: Original GameRecord.eventRefs identities and retained original execution/lifecycle facts only
publicTimelineContract.missingData: Explicit unavailable/unsupported; no invented past observation or millisecond trajectory
